messages:
Maya: launching a small social sprint for the release next week. Primary goals: drive webinar signups, surface the benchmark story, and route high-intent replies to SDRs.
Nora: timeline idea: Day0 teaser, Day2 benchmark thread (data + short code), Day4 webinar push, Day5 customer quote push, Day7 follow-up + nurture.
Eli: creative plan: 30s hero clip, 15s cut, 3-card carousel for LinkedIn, and a 3-tweet benchmark thread for X. Will need final copy and thumbnails by EOD tomorrow.
Sam: routing/tracking rules: all webinar CTAs must append utm_source and utm_campaign so webhook routes to the Webinar_SDR queue. Use utm_source=x_social for X and utm_source=linkedin for LinkedIn. Exact high-intent reply phrases = "Interested demo" OR "Book call". Signup tag = "webinar_signup" and lead_score=60. SDR triage window = 24hrs.
Maya: good. For X thumbnails: use the benchmark graph (big % callout), for LinkedIn thumbnails: product UI + headline. Nora, please prepare both variants in Figma.
Nora: will do. Figma link coming shortly. Also recommend pinning the benchmark thread on day2 and boosting the best performing X post to developer audiences.
Eli: copy ideas (short):
- Data lead: "3x faster inference, 2x lower cost. How we engineered inference for production. Webinar Thurs 11am PT. Register: {link}?utm_source=x_social&utm_campaign=may_micro"
- Dev quickstart: "Ship a working LLM feature in days  checklist + demo in our webinar. Register: {link}?utm_source=linkedin&utm_campaign=may_micro"
Maya: use data lead on X, quickstart on LinkedIn. Add the exact reply CTAs Sam specified.
Sam: webhook test queued  sample payload posted to #eng-infra. Response: 200 OK, routed -> Webinar_SDR (lead_score=60).
SocialBot: schedule preview created: https://redwood.social/schedule/preview/3219876543  items=5 posts, clips=2, carousels=1. Reaction :white_check_mark:.
Eli: plan a small A/B on the benchmark thread: A = metrics-led, B = developer checklist with mini code snippet. Metric: CTR to signup and count of high-intent replies.
Nora: paid plan: boost one X post (dev audience) and one LinkedIn sponsored (PMs). Budget proposal pending.
Maya: next steps: Eli finalize copy by 11am PT tomorrow, Nora deliver assets by EOD, Sam confirm webhook mapping + test log, final sign-off 10am PT tomorrow. Any blockers?
Eli: brand asked to reduce text in thumbnails for mobile; I'll adjust.
Sam: I'll set up tweet_id -> intake mapping so SDRs have context and can reply in-thread.
Maya: perfect. tagging for final check-in tomorrow 10am PT. :rocket:
